entry.title: Laboe Naval Memorial
entry.note: Exact mapped tower footprint with Q538382. Its pointed granite bow faces northwest toward the Kiel Fjord; the curved blank entrance wall faces the inland memorial courtyard southeast, as corroborated by the owner photographs. Ground contact uses host terrain. The neighboring memorial hall, colonnaded courtyard and U-995 submarine are separate site structures. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
